description: This is a code-behind file for the StartExam.aspx page in an online examination system. It handles page load events, session management, dynamic population of course selection based on user semester, and initiation of exams for theory and multiple-choice question (MCQ) types. It also includes navigation controls and logic for checking if a user has already taken an exam.

classes.name: StartExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the StartExam ASP.NET webpage, managing exam initiation logic, user session management, and course selection based on user semester.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial page load event, populating course dropdown based on the user's semester stored in session.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Navigation button event to redirect to Dashboard.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigation button event to redirect to user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Navigation button event to redirect to leaderboard page.

methods.name: startB_Click
methods.description: Starts an exam based on selected type (Theory or MCQ), verifies question availability, and sets session variables for the exam.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of theory exams, checking if already taken and initiating the exam.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of MCQ exams, checking if already taken and initiating the exam.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.
